home.orgCard1Detail: FIFA today. Chess, kabaddi, gatka, quiz and athletics to come. One organisation, one profile, every event you enter.
home.orgCard2Title: A trophy cabinet that follows you
home.orgCard2Detail: Every event you compete in and every award you win stays on your profile — across sports, across years.
home.orgCard3Detail: Meet Sikh players near you and online. Post that you're looking for a game, and get matched with someone who plays what you play.
home.whyLine1: Sixty-four players will walk in as strangers.
home.whyLine2: They won't walk out as strangers.
home.whySub: That's the point. The trophy is the excuse.
home.ctaBody: Two minutes. This registers your interest — it is not a place: all {capacity} are decided by a random draw after entries close. No entry fee, langar on the day, straight knockout.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Every Sikh World Championships event, past and upcoming. Each one is open to Sikh players of all levels — you don't need to be the best, you just need to turn up.
events.pastEmpty: No past events yet — Sikh FC 27 is the first.

event.unconfirmedStrong: Date and venue are being finalised.
event.unconfirmedRest: Register your place now — everyone who signs up gets the details by email as soon as they're confirmed.
event.factFormatSub: Win and you go through, lose and you are out
event.divisionOpenAges: Open to everyone aged {min} and over on the day
event.divisionAgeRange: Ages {min}–{max} on the day of the event
event.prizesNote: Every award also lands in your [[SWC trophy cabinet]] — a permanent record on your profile, across every event you ever enter.

registerInterest.title: Register interest
registerInterest.introLive: Free to enter, {capacity} places. Takes about two minutes.
registerInterest.notAPlaceStrong: This form registers your interest — it does not give you a place.
registerInterest.notAPlaceRest: All {capacity} places are decided by a random draw{closes}. You get a confirmation email as soon as you submit it, and another after the draw either way — so there is nothing to chase.
registerInterest.signedInRest: , so this attaches to your existing profile — no second account, and your details are already filled in. Check them, answer the questions about this event, and tick the consents.
registerInterest.createsProfile: This also creates your Sikh World Championships profile, which you keep for every future event.
registerInterest.detailsFinalising: Date and venue are being finalised. Sign up now to hold your place — we'll email you the details as soon as they're confirmed.
registerInterest.testingTitle: Testing mode — this saves a real record
registerInterest.testingBody1: Entries are closed to the public. This browser is holding a test key, so the form works for real: it writes to the live database and sends real emails. Use made-up details, and delete the entry from
registerInterest.testingBody2: when you are done. Close it again at
registerInterest.demoBody: Entries aren't open yet. This is the real form, with the real checks, so the team can see exactly what an entrant fills in — but submitting it stores nothing and does not hold you a place. Please don't enter anyone's real medical details.
registerInterest.closedBody1: We're finishing the last pieces before we can take entries safely — the parent and guardian notifications, and the systems that hold players' details properly. That work comes before the sign-up button, not after it.
registerInterest.closedDetailsToo: The date and venue are being finalised too.
registerInterest.closedBody2: Nothing is lost by waiting — all {capacity} places will be available when we open, and entry is free.

signupForm.prefillNoticeRest: Change anything that has changed — especially a phone number. Your medical answers and the consents below are asked again for every event, on purpose.
signupForm.dobHint: Checks you're old enough to compete. We never show your exact age publicly.
signupForm.regionHint: Region only — never your full address.
signupForm.eligibleRest: Everyone aged 12 to 25 competes in the same open bracket.
signupForm.tooYoung: You need to be at least {minAge} on the day of the event to compete. Come along and support anyway — and keep an eye out, we'll be running younger age groups at future events.
signupForm.guardianIntro: You're under 18, so we need a parent or guardian's details and their permission. This is how we keep everyone safe on the day.
signupForm.guardianByHeading: To be completed by the parent or guardian
signupForm.guardianConsent: I am this player's parent or guardian, and I give permission for them to take part.
signupForm.guardianOnSite: I will stay at the venue for the whole event.
signupForm.guardianOnSiteHint: Required for players under 16. You don't need to sit with them — there's seating, langar and the bracket on the big screen — but we need you in the building.
signupForm.guardianIndependent: I'm happy for them to come to the event on their own, and I'll be reachable on the number above.
signupForm.guardianIndependentHint: For players aged 16 and 17. Under 16s need a parent or guardian at the venue.
signupForm.mayLeaveUnaccompanied: They may leave the venue unaccompanied at the end of the day.
signupForm.mayLeaveUnaccompaniedHint: Optional. If you leave this, we'll expect them to be collected.
signupForm.dietarySelfManaged: They'll tell the team about any dietary needs when they arrive.
signupForm.dietarySelfManagedHint: Langar is served on the day. We don't hold a dietary list, so anything that matters — an allergy especially — needs saying at the counter. Put anything a first aider would need in the medical box below as well.
signupForm.referral: How did you hear about this?
signupForm.referralHint: Places are limited. Applicants referred by a partner organisation are drawn first.
signupForm.referralDetailHint: Just the name — it tells us which outreach is working.
signupForm.emergencyIntro: Someone we can call on the day if you're hurt or unwell. Not you — someone who isn't at the event.
signupForm.emergencyMinorRest: we'll use the parent or guardian details above, so there's nothing extra to fill in here.
signupForm.medicalConditionsHint: Tick anything that applies. Our first aider reads this, so 'None' is a real answer we need.
signupForm.medicalDetail: Anything else our first aider should know
signupForm.medicalDetailHint: Which inhaler, which allergy, what to do — the detail a first aider would actually need. Leave blank if nothing applies.
signupForm.accessibilityHint: Wheelchair access, quiet space, anything else — just ask.
signupForm.rulesAgreed: I've read the rules and the code of conduct, and I'll play by them.
signupForm.termsNotAPlaceStrong: This registers your interest — it is not a place.
signupForm.termsNotAPlaceRest: All {capacity} places are decided by a random draw after entries close. We email you either way, and we email you now to confirm we have this form.
signupForm.termsProfileStrong: If you get a place, we'll create your SWC profile.
signupForm.termsProfileRest: It saves your results and trophies across every event you play in, and you sign in with this email address — no password. If you don't get a place this time, no profile is created.
signupForm.termsPhotoStrong: Photos and video are taken at the event.
signupForm.termsPhotoMinor: By registering you agree your child may appear in them, on our website, our social media, and in material promoting future events. Not for sale, not for sponsors' own advertising. If you'd rather they were not filmed, tell us before the day and our photographers are told.
signupForm.termsPhotoAdult: By registering you agree you may appear in them, on our website, our social media, and in material promoting future events. Not for sale, not for sponsors' own advertising. If you'd rather not be filmed, tell us before the day and our photographers are told.
signupForm.termsIdMinorStrong: They must bring proof of their date of birth on the day.
signupForm.termsIdAdultStrong: You must bring proof of your date of birth on the day.
signupForm.termsIdMinorRest: Anything that shows it — a birth certificate, a passport, an NHS card, a school or college letter or card that carries the date of birth. [[A photo of it on a phone is fine]], so nothing has to leave the house. It is checked at the door to collect their slip, then handed straight back: we write down nothing from it, only that we saw a date of birth. Age decides the bracket and the supervision rules, so this is the one thing we check rather than take on trust.
signupForm.termsIdAdultRest: Anything that shows it — a birth certificate, a passport, an NHS card, a school or college letter or card that carries the date of birth. [[A photo of it on a phone is fine]], so nothing has to leave the house. It is checked at the door to collect your slip, then handed straight back: we write down nothing from it, only that we saw a date of birth. Age decides the bracket and the supervision rules, so this is the one thing we check rather than take on trust.
signupForm.termsEmailRest: Your confirmation, the result of the draw, and news about future events all come by email — there is nothing else to sign up to.
signupForm.termsOptOut: Anything here can be stopped at any time — before the day or after it — at [[sikhchampionships.com/support]], with no effect on your place.
signupForm.failureFooter: Nothing has been submitted yet. Fix the above and press the button again.
signupForm.networkError: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again — nothing has been submitted.
signupForm.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
signupForm.rehearsalBody1: Fills every box with made-up details for a 13-year-old — the longest path through the form, so it exercises the guardian section and the guardian email.
signupForm.rehearsalBody2: Your own email address is left blank on purpose
signupForm.rehearsalBody3: — type one you can actually read, in both boxes, or the emails go nowhere.
signupForm.submitNote: Free to enter. {capacity} places, more applications than places expected.
signupForm.successDemoRest: This is what an applicant would see. No application has been recorded.
signupForm.successBody1: Thanks {firstName}. This is a registration of interest, not a place yet: there are {capacity} places and we expect more interest than that.
signupForm.successBody2: Applications close {closeDate}, then places are drawn. [[We'll email you either way]] — you don't need to do anything until then.
signupForm.successEmailedMinor: We've emailed you a copy and told your parent or guardian. Your Sikh World Championships profile is set up with this email address — you can sign in any time, and it carries over to every future event. If you get a place we'll send a check-in code for the day.
signupForm.successEmailedAdult: We've emailed you a copy. Your Sikh World Championships profile is set up with this email address — you can sign in any time, and it carries over to every future event. If you get a place we'll send a check-in code for the day.

bracket.title: Live bracket
bracket.emptyTitle: The bracket goes live on the day
bracket.emptyBody: Once places are drawn and the first round is set, it appears here and updates as scores come in — on the big screen in the hall, and on this page for anyone following from home.
bracket.reconnecting: Reconnecting — showing the last bracket we had
bracket.demoNoticeStrong: Below: demo data — not real players.
bracket.demoNoticeRest: Shown outside production only, so the layout can be checked before anyone has registered.
bracket.demoDivisionSub: Straight knockout — all 64 players, first round to final.

join.metaDescription: One Sikh World Championships profile, every event. Register interest in an event and your profile is created with it.
join.introSignedInRest: . You don't need to make another profile — register interest in the events you want and they all attach to this one.
join.introSignedOut1: One profile, every Sikh World Championships event.
join.introSignedOut2: There is no separate sign-up — registering interest in an event below is what creates it.
join.introSignedOut3: After that, entering a new event is confirming details we already hold, not typing them again.
join.startBodySignedIn: Your name, contact details and — if you're under 18 — your parent or guardian's details are already with us, so they're filled in for you. What's left is the questions about the event, your medical answers, and the consents. Those are asked every time, on purpose.
join.startBodySignedOut: Registering interest in your first event is what creates your profile — there is no separate sign-up form, and no details to enter twice. Places are drawn, so registering interest is not a place; we'll email you either way.
join.alreadyRegisteredAfter: — no password, we email you a link.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: No password. Put in the email address you used when you entered an event, and we'll send you a link.
signin.footnote: Haven't entered an event yet? You get an account automatically when you do — there's no separate sign-up to do first.
signin.errorExpired: That link had expired — they only last 15 minutes. Here's a fresh one.
signin.errorUsed: That link had already been used. Ask for a new one.
signin.errorInvalid: That link wasn't valid. Ask for a new one.
signin.sentBody1: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
signin.sentBody2: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, and make sure you used the same address you entered the event with.
signin.rateLimited: That's a lot of attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
signin.needEmail: Enter the email address you signed up with.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.visibilityNever: Never your surname, your school, your address, your exact age or your email. Your PlayStation ID is only shared with someone once you have both agreed to a game — it is never on the bracket or the big screen, because anyone could then look you up on PlayStation.
profile.guardianMissing: We don't have a parent or guardian's email for you. Get in touch through Support and we'll add one.
profile.boardOnSuffix: for you. They can change that at any time.
profile.trophiesEmpty: Nothing yet — the first event hasn't happened. Trophies you win are saved here across every SWC event.

players.title: Players
players.intro: Every player who enters an event gets a Sikh World Championships profile — a player card, and a trophy cabinet that follows them across every sport and every year.
players.emptyBody: Player cards and trophy cabinets fill up as events are held. The first ones go out at Sikh FC 27 in Leicester.
players.demoNote: Demo data, shown outside production only.
players.cabinetEmpty: No trophies yet. Enter an event.

sponsors.title: Sponsors
sponsors.intro: Sponsorship is what keeps entry free. It pays for the venue, the consoles, the prizes and the langar — so that no young person is priced out of competing.
sponsors.whatYouGet1: Logo on this page, on the event page, and on the big screen beside the live bracket
sponsors.whatYouGet2: An offer to every profile holder — a discount only our players can use, reaching them directly rather than through an advert they scroll past
sponsors.whatYouGet3: Presence at the event, and mentions across the day
sponsors.whatYouGet4: Association with a community event that is free to enter, by design
sponsors.pitchBody: Sixty-four players aged 12 to 25, their families in the room with them, and a free day out built by volunteers. It is the first event of its kind for Sikh youth in the UK, and the people in that hall are the ones you want to reach.
sponsors.tellUs1: Who you are, and what you do
sponsors.tellUs2: What you would like to give — money, equipment, prizes, food, or an offer for our players
sponsors.tellUs3: If it is an offer: what it is, the code, and how long it lasts
sponsors.tellUs4: Whether you want your logo on the screen on the day
sponsors.tellUs5: Whether anyone from your team wants to be there
sponsors.tellUs6: Anything you need from us in return, so we can say yes or no honestly

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.intro: A 64-player event needs roughly 15 people to run properly. If you can give a day, we'd be glad to have you.
volunteer.role1Detail: scanning QR codes, handing out wristbands
volunteer.role2Detail: one per few stations, settling disputes, starting matches
volunteer.role3Detail: keeping the live bracket up to date (one dedicated person)
volunteer.howBody: Tell us which role suits you and whether you can give the whole day. No account needed.

support.title: Contact us
support.metaDescription: Ask us anything, raise a safety concern, or tell us you want your details deleted. Open to players, parents and guardians — no account needed.
support.intro: Ask us anything, raise a safety concern, or tell us to delete your details. You don't need an account, and you don't have to give your name.
support.emergencyTitle: If someone is in immediate danger
support.emergencyBody: Call [[999]]. If you're worried about a child's safety and it isn't an emergency, the NSPCC helpline is [[0808 800 5000]], and Childline is [[0800 1111]] — both free, and Childline is confidential.
support.emergencyFootnote: Please still tell us as well, so we can act on our side.
support.footnote: This form is the way to reach us. Anything about a young person's safety jumps to the top of the queue and is read by a moderator. You can send it without an account and without giving your name.
support.formMessagePlaceholderUrgent: What happened, who was involved, and when. Include anything you can — names, dates, what was said.
support.formMessagePlaceholder: As much detail as you can give us.
support.formReachIntro: You can leave these blank and send it anonymously. We'd rather hear from you anonymously than not hear from you at all — but without an email we can't come back to you.
support.formGuardianHint: So we know to reply to you rather than to a young person.
support.doneUrgent: This has gone straight to the top of our moderators' queue. Someone will look at it within 24 hours.
support.doneNormal: We'll come back to you as soon as we can — usually within a few days.
support.errorNoCategory: Pick what your message is about.
support.errorTooShort: Tell us a bit more so we can actually help.
support.errorRateLimited: That's a lot of messages in a short time. If this is urgent, use the emergency contacts above the form — they reach a person directly.

guardian.invalidBody: It may have been mistyped, or replaced by a newer request. Ask your child to request permission again, or [[get in touch]] and we'll sort it out.
guardian.expiredBody: Permission requests stay open for 30 days. Ask {childName} to request it again and you'll get a fresh link.
guardian.pendingBody: {childName} would like to use the Sikh World Championships "Find a game" board, where young Sikh players arrange games with each other. Because they're under 16, we need your permission first.
guardian.approvedBody: You gave permission on {date}. You can withdraw it below at any time — access stops immediately.
guardian.declinedBody: {childName} can't use the board. You can allow it below if you change your mind.
guardian.footnote: Questions, or something doesn't look right? [[Tell us]]. If you didn't expect this email, say so — it matters.

play.title: Find a game
play.closedBody: This is built, but it isn't switched on yet. It lets you find another Sikh player to practise against — you pick a game, a platform and when you're free, and other players send you a request.
play.closedHow1: No messaging and no typing, for anyone. Everything is built from set options.
play.closedHow2: Under-16s and over-16s never mix, and adults cannot reach an under-16.
play.closedHow3: Under-16s need a parent or guardian to switch it on, and they can switch it off again at any time.
play.closedHow4: Gamertags are only shared once two players have both agreed to a game.
play.closedHow5: Report and block on every post, with real moderators behind them.
play.closedFootnote: We're waiting on the parent and guardian notification emails before this opens. That promise has to work before anyone under 16 is here, not after.
play.signedOutBody: Sign in to see the board. It shows other players' first names and regions, so it isn't public.
play.signedOutFootnote: You get an account automatically when you enter an event — there's no separate sign-up.
play.needsGuardianBody: You're under 16, so a parent or guardian needs to switch this on for you first. We'll email them and they can turn it on in one click.
play.needsGuardian1: You'll only ever see, and be seen by, other under-16 players. Adults cannot reach you here at all.
play.needsGuardian2: There's no messaging and no typing. Posts and requests are built from set options.
play.needsGuardian3: Your gamertag is only shared when you both agree to a game.
play.needsGuardian4: They'll get an email telling them each time you connect with someone.
play.needsGuardian5: They can switch it off again whenever they want.
play.guardianDeclined: Your parent or guardian has said no for now. Talk to them — they can change their mind at any time using the link we sent them.
play.boardIntro: Sikh players looking for someone to play with. Say what you play and when you're free, send a request, and swap gamertags once you both agree.
play.u16NoticeRest: Everyone here is under 16 too — adults can't see you or contact you. Your parent or guardian gets an email whenever you connect with someone.
play.readyFootnote: Add each other on PlayStation and play from there.
play.boardEmpty: Nobody's posted yet. Put yours up and you'll be first.
play.safetyRest: under-16s and over-16s are kept completely separate, there's no free typing at strangers, and gamertags are only shared once you both agree to a game. Report and block are on every post, a moderator reads every report, and under-16s need a guardian's permission to be here at all.
play.composerOpenHint: Say what you play and when you're free. Other players send you a request.
play.composerWindowsHint: Pick as many as you like. We don't show whether you're online — nobody should feel they have to be available.
play.composerNoteHint: Set notes only — there's no free typing on the board, which is what keeps it safe without anyone having to police it.
play.postVerifiedTitle: Came to an SWC event and was checked in by a volunteer
play.postRequestSent: Request sent. If {name} accepts, you'll both get each other's gamertag and can play.
play.postReportHint: A moderator reads every report. You won't be named to the person you're reporting.
play.askGuardianSentTitle: We've emailed your parent or guardian.
play.askGuardianSentBody: As soon as they say yes, the board opens up for you. Give them a nudge if they haven't seen it.

api.entriesClosed: Entries aren't open yet. We're finishing the guardian notifications and the systems that hold players' details properly before we take any entries.
